verdict.rationale: Recruitee offers a dedicated, labeled Careers API token that is limited to the careers endpoints (/offers, /offers/:id, /offers/:offer_slug/candidates). This is a narrow, least-privilege credential an agent could use for job listing and application flows. The main company API, by contrast, uses a bearer token from token settings, and the evidence shows no configurable scopes, read-only modes, or per-resource permissions for it, so scoping is coarse and limited to one fixed token type. Missing for 10: configurable per-scope or read/write permissions on the full company API, token expiry or rotation controls, per-agent permission granularity beyond the fixed Careers token, and independent corroboration.
